newsitem.title: USA: Allegiance says officers buy 2.4 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Allegiance says officers buy 2.4 mln shrs.

text.p: Allegiance Corp said 2.4 million shares of its stock, valued at about $54.8 million, were purchased by 141 company officers who agreed to participate in a voluntary program.

The shares were purchased at 23-1/4 on Friday by executives who took out full-recourse, five-year personal loans to finance the purchases, said Allegiance, spun off in September by Baxter International Inc.
The shares represent about 4.1 percent of Allegiance's total shares outstanding, it said.
"Our management team has cast a very personal vote of confidence in the company," said Lester Knight, chairman and chief executive officer of Allegiance.

Last week, Allegiance reported first-quarter earnings rose 39 percent over the previous year's period. The company earned $21 million on sales of $1.06 billion versus year-ago pro forma net income of $15.1 million on revenues of $4.4 billion.
